title: Concatenation of safe segments
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine, $F$ a set of states, and $P$ a predicate on work-tape head positions. If there is a safe segment from $a$ to $b$ of length $t$ and a safe segment from $b$ to $c$ of length $v$, both relative to $F$ and $P$, then there is a safe segment from $a$ to $c$ of length $t+v$.
